note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 4724 Section 4.1 ('It MUST NOT differentiate between stale and other information during forwarding.') and {single-polarity: positive}. startupSweep only gained a refuse-by-default comment; it still records stale ownership solely in memory (retained and staleTables) with zero backend adds, replaces, or deletes, leaving surviving forwarding entries indistinguishable from fresh routes.
